headline: 23 Large Networks and Over a Thousand Sole Proprietors: Tax Authority Exposes Large-Scale 'Business Fragmentation'
summary: Since the start of 2026, the State Tax Service has identified more than 500 brands and trademarks possibly linked to artificial business fragmentation schemes used to evade taxes.
why: Tax enforcement against fragmentation schemes affects company compliance costs and the integrity of Ukraine's tax base.
